article.title: Penalty for non-reporting.
article.content: Any person who has committed an offence under section 33 shall be liable to imprisonment up to six months or fine of ten thousand rupees or both.
article.html:
34Penalty for non-reporting.

Section 34 · Chapter VI · page 24 of the Act

Any person who has committed an offence under section 33 shall be liable to imprisonment up to six months or fine of ten thousand rupees or both.
